channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Palau and the absurd case for international nicotine prohibition
item.description: Palau's proposal to bring nicotine under the UN's international drug control system has raised concerns about the future of tobacco harm reduction. (Published on November 09, 2026bycenterforglobalhealthaccountability.org)

item.title: UK youth study calls for vapes to be positioned as quit
item.description: Young people may be more open to tobacco harm reduction than policymakers assume. A University of Sheffield study found that teenage participants supported presenting vapes more clearly as smoking cessation aids, while opposing flavour bans that could limit options for adults trying to quit cigarettes. (Published on November 09, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)

item.title: FDA Recognizes Nicotine Harm Reduction as Brussels Questions Science
item.description: The US FDA has authorised 24 additional nicotine pouch products, bringing the total to 67, while explicitly recognising their potential to help adults switch away from more harmful tobacco products. (Published on November 09, 2026bypouchforum.eu)
